stop_rules.note: a 429 is waited out with a doubling pause and the same request is asked again; three in a row end the run; no other address, no proxy, no retry around a refusal

purpose: GASCYCLE zero-try count (Idea Desk C, owner MAIN): settled market lists of the Ohio and Indiana daily gas series, closes before 2026-10-15 only, for each day's settled state average (expiration_value). No candle is requested and no price field is read.
heldout: GASCYCLE held-out is D 2026-10-15 to before 2026-12-15: every request carries max_close_ts = 1792022400 (2026-10-15T00:00:00Z), so no held-out market is requested. USWEEP1 and GAS1-F (frozen 79724f00) hold KXAAAGASD* windows that are never read; W-CAT-ECON1 was released Nov 13. The reader keeps only ticker, event_ticker, close_time, strike fields, expiration_value and result.
notes: Two series, each its settled live list with close from 2024-01-01 to before 2026-10-15, up to 12 pages of 1,000 (a daily ladder of about 10 to 30 strikes from the series start, unknown, to Oct 15 is at most about 10,000 markets a series). The live list holds markets closed after about 2026-09-13 only; older markets are in GASCYCLE_COUNT_HIST, a separate file because that endpoint takes no date bound. At most 24 pages, cap 26. Fields kept: ticker, event_ticker, close_time, floor_strike, cap_strike, strike_type, expiration_value, result.
